<a id="getAddress()">
<!--   -->

<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>getAddress</h4>
<pre class="methodSignature">@NonNull
public&nbsp;<a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-address" title="class in com.here.sdk.search">Address</a>&nbsp;getAddress()</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Gets the address of the place.
 <p>Note that while <code>OfflineSearchEngine.suggest</code> and <code>OfflineSearchEngine.suggestByText</code> set all available details,
 <code>SearchEngine.suggest</code> and <code>SearchEngine.suggestByText</code> set only <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-address#addressText"><code>Address.addressText</code></a>.
 Complete address details can be obtained by searching with <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-placeidquery" title="class in com.here.sdk.search"><code>PlaceIdQuery</code></a>.</div>
<dl>
<dt><span class="returnLabel">Returns:</span></dt>
<dd><p>The address of the place.
     <p>Note that while <code>OfflineSearchEngine.suggest</code> and <code>OfflineSearchEngine.suggestByText</code> set all available details,
     <code>SearchEngine.suggest</code> and <code>SearchEngine.suggestByText</code> set only <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-address#addressText"><code>Address.addressText</code></a>.
     Complete address details can be obtained by searching with <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-placeidquery" title="class in com.here.sdk.search"><code>PlaceIdQuery</code></a>.</dd>
</dl>
</li>
</ul>

<a id="isCoordinatesInterpolated()">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>isCoordinatesInterpolated</h4>
<pre class="methodSignature">public&nbsp;boolean&nbsp;isCoordinatesInterpolated()</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Gets the flag saying whether the coordinates of the house number were interpolated or not.
 <p>This property is valid only for house number results retrieved using online search.
 When false, it means <a href="#getGeoCoordinates()"><code>getGeoCoordinates()</code></a> point to an accurate position of the house. Otherwise
 coordinates are slightly less accurate, but are based on a highly optimized interpolation algorithm.</div>
<dl>
<dt><span class="returnLabel">Returns:</span></dt>
<dd><p>A property that says whether the coordinates of the house number were interpolated or not.</dd>
</dl>
</li>
</ul>
<a id="getAccessPoints()">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>getAccessPoints</h4>
<pre class="methodSignature">@NonNull
public&nbsp;java.util.List&lt;<a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-geocoordinates" title="class in com.here.sdk.core">GeoCoordinates</a>&gt;&nbsp;getAccessPoints()</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Gets the access points to the place, such as the points on a road or in a parking lot.
 <p>A place can have multiple access points. For example, a large warehouse can have
 multiple entrances, while the center of the warehouse may not be directly reachable.
 Note that access points are meant to be reachable by vehicles.
 For routes it is recommended to navigate to one of the available access points (if any),
 whereas the <code>sideOfStreetHint</code> should be set to the geographic coordinates of the place.
 The list is empty when no access points are known or when the place is directly reachable.
 A place can have multiple access points. For example, a large warehouse can have
 multiple entrances, while the center of the warehouse may not be directly reachable.
 Note that access points are meant to be reachable by vehicles.
 For routes it is recommended to navigate to one of the available access points (if any),
 whereas the <code>sideOfStreetHint</code> should be set to the geographic coordinates of the place.
 The list is empty when no access points are known or when the place is directly reachable.</div>
<dl>
<dt><span class="returnLabel">Returns:</span></dt>
<dd><p>The access points to the place, such as the points on a road or in a parking lot.</dd>
</dl>
</li>
</ul>

<pre class="methodSignature">@Nullable

<div class="block"><p>Gets the distance from the search center to the place in meters.</div>

<ul class="blockListLast">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>getPoliticalView</h4>
<pre class="methodSignature">@Nullable
public&nbsp;java.lang.String&nbsp;getPoliticalView()</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Gets the geopolitical view, defined as a three letter country code, each disputed territory has international and alternative views.
 <p>Populated when the geopolitical view parameter is set in the <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-sdkoptions" title="class in com.here.sdk.core.engine"><code>SDKOptions</code></a>
 and passed to <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-sdknativeengine" title="class in com.here.sdk.core.engine"><code>SDKNativeEngine</code></a> on instantiation,
 but only if it is an alternative view.
 For more details refer to <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-sdkoptions" title="class in com.here.sdk.core.engine"><code>SDKOptions</code></a>.</div>
<dl>
<dt><span class="returnLabel">Returns:</span></dt>
<dd><p>The geopolitical view, defined as a three letter country code, each disputed territory has international and alternative views.</dd>
</dl>
</li>
</ul>
